evidence.claim: The paper reports that union-find decoding operates in practice with O(n) complexity for both 2D independent and 3D phenomenological noise models, even without union-by-size and path compression.
The decoder's erasure clusters remain in a strictly sparse, non-percolating regime as lattice size grows, undermining worst-case assumptions that cluster size scales with the full lattice.
The peeling stage first removes cycles to form a spanning forest and then iteratively prunes leaves to obtain a maximum-likelihood cover of the syndrome.
